say:1:1033715001:1.text: We Dusk Patrollers, the Thorned Guards, and the Windwhispers are all children of Misarte.
say:1:1033715001:1.source_cn: 薄暮、荆棘以及风语永远是弥萨忒的子民。
say:1:1033715001:1.male: We Dusk Patrollers, the Thorned Guards, and the Windwhispers are all children of Misarte.
say:1:1033715001:1.female: We Dusk Patrollers, the Thorned Guards, and the Windwhispers are all children of Misarte.

say:2:1033715002:1.text: And when it comes to being tolerant, how can we even measure up to Misarte?
say:2:1033715002:1.source_cn: 若论宽容，我们又怎么能和弥萨忒相比！
say:2:1033715002:1.male: And when it comes to being tolerant, how can we even measure up to Misarte?
say:2:1033715002:1.female: And when it comes to being tolerant, how can we even measure up to Misarte?

say:3:1033715003:1.text: Though we are all sinners, she has never forsaken us but continues to protect the forest and mountains just as always.
say:3:1033715003:1.source_cn: 我们犯下这样的错误……祂依然没有放弃我们，庇佑着丛林和山脉。
say:3:1033715003:1.male: Though we are all sinners, she has never forsaken us but continues to protect the forest and mountains just as always.
say:3:1033715003:1.female: Though we are all sinners, she has never forsaken us but continues to protect the forest and mountains just as always.
